title: Audit writer with hash chain and redaction
description: Audit writer with hash chain and redaction.
acceptance: Records follow ATA-06:10 (JSON Lines, SHA-256 hash chain, defined event types)
Redaction is enforced at write time: no keys, proof material, long-term identity or personal data
Chain head is serialized in the Durable Object
findings: Correction: imported plan built the audit chain in phase 5 but required every write to be audited from phase 2.
